title: Where Your Package Goes While You Sleep
description:
ZERO forgot his mom's birthday. It's tomorrow, on the other side of the country, and the screen says 10:30 AM. So he climbs into the box and rides it through the night: a truck in the rain, a plane to Kentucky, a building that sorts more than 400,000 packages an hour, a wet label with ten seconds to save it, and a storm that shut the whole hub down.

Zero doesn't know how the world works. Yet.

Every number in this video has a source. FACT = stated by the source; ESTIMATE = reported by a visit, interview or older source and may have changed.
- 400,000+ packages an hour, 5.2M sq ft, 95% of the U.S. within a 4-hour flight, ~20,000 employees (FACT): UPS Jobs, "UPS Worldport" https://www.jobs-ups.com/us/en/ups-worldport
- About one landing per minute at peak, 155 miles of belts, self-parking docks, December volume roughly doubling (ESTIMATE): AeroSavvy, Apr 25 2017 https://aerosavvy.com/ups-worldport/
- Camera tunnels, ~10 seconds for a person to read an unreadable label, night sort timing (ESTIMATE): Engadget, Jan 3 2013 https://www.engadget.com/2013-01-03-inside-ups-worldport-sorting-hub.html
- 150+ miles of conveyor belts (ESTIMATE): Industrial Distribution, Jun 25 2015 https://www.inddist.com/home/news/13767858/a-look-at-how-upss-worldport-is-transforming-the-supply-chain
- ULD air cargo containers (FACT): Ship4wd https://ship4wd.com/import-guides/air-freight-containers
- Next Day Air delivery by 10:30 AM, noon or end of day (FACT): Stamps.com https://www.stamps.com/faq/what-are-the-delivery-times-for-ups-next-day-air/
- April 2, 2025 sort suspended for severe weather (FACT): WDRB/WAVE https://www.wdrbwave.com/2025/04/03/ups-worldport-suspends-operations-flights-due-severe-weather-threat/
- FedEx Memphis ~484,000 packages an hour (FACT): FreightWaves, Feb 5 2026 https://www.freightwaves.com/news/fedex-preparing-major-sort-center-expansion-at-memphis-air-hub
- DHL Leipzig 150,000+ shipments an hour (FACT): DHL, Sep 2018 https://www.dhl.com/global-en/delivered/insights/sorting-at-the-speed-of-yellow-dhls-hub-leipzig-is-10.html
- Metropolitan College (FACT): UPS Jobs https://www.jobs-ups.com/us/en/metropolitan-college
- Route software that avoids left turns, up to 10M gallons a year (ESTIMATE, UPS figures): Mental Floss, Mar 6 2017 https://mentalfloss.com/article/92884/why-dont-ups-drivers-turn-left
- $1B+ Worldport expansion, 2002 (FACT): Post & Parcel, Sep 30 2002 https://postandparcel.info/6989/news/ups-wraps-up-1-billion-expansion-in-louisville/
- 50 cities: 1,225 direct routes vs 50 through one hub: our own calculation (50x49/2).
The times on screen, mom's address and ZERO's own box are part of the story, not claims.
